title: Budd Hopkins' abductees all drew the same symbol

tellings.quote: and he said I want you to draw what you see on the inside of the ship on the the table and they all drew the same symbol on the wall

plain: In New York in the 2000s, a group of people who said they had been taken aboard alien craft were each asked to draw what they had seen inside the ship, and they all drew the same symbol from the wall. The filmmaker James Fox tells Michels he was there when it happened, at a session run by Budd Hopkins, a New York researcher who worked with people reporting abductions, and he also names the journalist Leslie Kean. If it is true, people who had never compared notes remembered the same detail.
